verdict.rationale: Evidence shows no general Kick API: OpenAPI/swagger probes all 404'd, the only MCP endpoint found is a GitBook docs-search server explicitly noted to serve documentation, not Kick account data or ledger actions, and the AI workflow route is one-directional Google Sheets report export (with limited spreadsheet write-back, not writing into Kick). There is no evidence of programmatic access to core UI actions like categorization, reconciliation, invoicing, or entity management.
